window: stock 1920x985 pt, largest layer-0 Device Hub Pro window
workload: HOME, open the app drawer + 6 flings, open/close Settings with 3 flings, rotate 0 -> 1 -> 0
baseline: 2026-09-24, MMAP default: Pixel 9 Pro Fold AVD on emulator 37.2.8 started with -gpu host -qt-hide-window, debug build, no transport variables, macOS 27 arm64. Workload 8/8 PASS: 60.1 fps peak, 0 % dropped, 7.1 ms, 21.9 % CPU, 390 MB, guest p50 17 ms, 8.4 % janky. Idle 5.6 % with in-app audio on (15.9 % before 239411c). launch-median-s and soak-footprint-growth-pct keep the 2026-09-20 raw-transport values (not re-measured). The bounds fail a fall back to raw frames (37.2.8 raw: 53 fps, 12 % dropped, 27 ms, 41 % CPU, 829 MB) and a software-GPU emulator (guest p50 93 ms, 26.6 fps); an emulator older than 37.2.3 has no MMAP and fails the stream checks by design. The 2026-09-20 raw baseline is the reference at 4f528a2 (git show 4f528a2:Scripts/perf-reference.json) for PERF_REFERENCE.
